# Neo's copy of the Neural Link capability matrix goes once the Brain receives it, and its links point at the Brain's

## Context

`learn/agentos/tooling/NeuralLinkCapabilityMatrix.md` is an operation-by-operation reference to the Brain's Neural Link registry (`openapi.yaml`, `toolService.mjs`). The registry and its guard spec are the Brain's. The census owner re-dispositioned the file to the Brain under ADR 0040 §5 ([decision](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-brain/issues/1117#issuecomment-6246813526)), and neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1118 receives it. This ticket is the remove step, so that one canonical copy remains.

The same paragraph of `learn/agentos/NeuralLink.md` carries a second registry fact that an Engine guide cannot keep in the same change: "At the time of this rewrite, the OpenAPI surface exposes 59 operation IDs." The registry has 60 since `drive_drag` (neomjs/neo-agent-brain#204, 08-30). The Brain's `GuideToolParity.spec`, read against the installed engine, fails on exactly that sentence.

## Trigger

This starts when neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1118 merges. The removal PR links that received Brain revision and the decision.

## The Consumers

- `learn/agentos/NeuralLink.md`: two links to `./tooling/NeuralLinkCapabilityMatrix.md`, and the operation-count sentence.
- `learn/guides/testing/DockLayoutsTesting.md`: one link.
- `learn/tree.json`: the `agentos/tooling/NeuralLinkCapabilityMatrix` entry.
- Generated and pipeline-owned, never hand-edited: `apps/portal/llms.txt` and `apps/portal/sitemap.xml`. `rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.mjs` rebuilds them from the tree.
- Any other live consumer, found with `git grep NeuralLinkCapabilityMatrix` at removal time.

## The Fix

1. Delete neo's copy.
2. Re-point the three links to `https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-brain/blob/dev/learn/agentos/tooling/NeuralLinkCapabilityMatrix.md`, as `NeuralLink.md` already does for `openapi.yaml`.
3. Remove the tree entry.
4. Drop the operation-count sentence. The guide already delegates the exact surface to `openapi.yaml` and `get_mcp_tool_handbook`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1:** neo carries no copy, and `git grep NeuralLinkCapabilityMatrix` finds only links to the Brain's copy.
- [ ] **AC-2:** the tree no longer lists the page, so the next SEO rebuild drops it from the portal's `llms.txt` and sitemap. Publication is part of this change, per the decision.
- [ ] **AC-3:** the PR body links the decision and the received Brain revision.
- [ ] **AC-4:** `NeuralLink.md` states no operation count.

## Paired Brain Follow-up

Once the Brain's engine pin includes this change, `GuideToolParity.spec` reads the guide through `neo.mjs/learn/agentos/NeuralLink.md`. Its count check becomes conditional, as its own comment already states: any explicit claim must match the registry. That clears its #201 red. The obligation is recorded on neomjs/neo-agent-brain#201.

## Out of Scope

- `learn/agentos/NeuralLink.md`'s concept and the App-side possession surface stay Engine-owned.
